name: Vite
description: Frontend build tool and dev server.
summary: Vite welcomes thoughtful AI use, but contributors must write all comments, issues, and pull request descriptions in their own words and must fully understand and explain any contribution they submit. Violations may cause the issue or pull request to be closed.

evidence.quote: We welcome the thoughtful use of AI tools when contributing to Vite, but ask all contributors to follow [two core principles](https://roe.dev/blog/using-ai-in-open-source):
**Never let an LLM think for you** - only submit contributions you fully understand and can explain.
**Never let an LLM speak for you** - all comments, issues, and PR descriptions should be written in your own words, reflecting your own understanding.
If we find that these principles were not followed, we may close the issue or pull request directly.
